name: v13-temporal-credit-small-factorial-v1
start: runs/retained/selected/latest.pt; original scratch-A 16384 decisions; actor/critic/both Adam/RNG restored identically
actor: unchanged official 13D GRU 26181 parameters and native decoder; no extra controls or external weights
fixed_training: stage A ground starts, same rewards/learning rates/entropy .025/opponent/std .35; all cells 4096 decisions per PPO update, 4 weighted-gradient epochs per update; same optimizer-step count and starting RNG
optimizer_cadence_change: All cells accumulate sample-weighted full-trajectory gradients before a single step per epoch; avoids length confounding through different numbers of Adam steps. This differs from old trainer for every cell.
GRU: Full chronological trajectory per new match, no goal resets; never combine separate matches; time-limit critic bootstrap; fresh on-policy collection per update
forecast_validation: No native recordings available in NEW repo; synthetic stress is labeled counterfactual sensitivity only and never training data/forecast labels. Regularization is encoder-input-column L2 only, no runtime feature changes.
matched_opponent: untouched official V13; frozen playing A also screened against same opponent/seeds
screen_qualification: Candidate must improve matched ground/contact metrics and conservative complete-match score >0.5 (caps as losses); no selection from reward/gradients alone
promotion: Unused-seed pair sign p<.05 with all capped results counted as losses AND actual Windows RLBot GUI/game acceptance. Linux cannot provide the latter: no promotion in this task.
existing_submission: Main c151310 already green; never replace it with an unaccepted candidate
